ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the perimeter and in focal streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of a continuous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid contiguous band along the entire trailing edge and outer tips. Several vertical low-intensity streaks/smudges are mapped near the median notch and the medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees with a depth extending roughly 1/5th into the vertical plane of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and U-shaped valleys are present, particularly on the inner halves of both lobes, creating a non-linear pixel boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating at the median notch and sweeping upward and outward to acute, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, textured grey/white pixel groups localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular notches and jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge contour; significant colonization of calcified-looking material at the outer lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark-pigmented focal smudge is located on the lower margin of the left lobe, immediately adjacent to the median notch.
